How it sells

Sells on the live chart, every minute (the chart exit, since Oct 24): 15% under its highest price once it has reached 1.5x, on a fall of 15% within 30 minutes, at −50%, at 11x or after 6 h, each at that minute. The fixed rule before it (−30%, 11x, 6 h) runs on as shadow rule K on the same trades. The trades before the start (132) are in the archive under “Three paper traders”.

The Radar's trades end at its own sale, so they cannot replay other sell rules: they are compared below, not trained on. Its range: coins 1 hour to 3 days old with real trading (24 h volume at least 10% of the market cap).

How it picks A model trained on 5 months of launches (28,279 coins) reads what the launch radar found at the launch (how long the coin took to launch, the creator's earlier hits, its X link, whether other coins with the same words launched that day) and the first 30 minutes of its chart. It buys the top 2 % (about 3 to 5 coins a day).

How it sells Rocket hold, on minute closes: at half the buy price; once it doubled, 40 % under its best; else after 24 hours.

Its test It counts only if its first 30 days pass the review bar (at least 40 trades, in profit after costs, also without its best trade), judged on Nov 27. On the months it learned from, the same rule lost −7.80 € per 20 € trade: it found 3 times more rockets than chance, but not enough to pay for the rest.

          The big search of 21 Oct 2026: nothing beat the gates on untouched data (research/SEARCH-2026-10-21.md)
          • 2 months of history (Aug to Oct, 18,700 coins): 123,120 combinations tried. The best on train and check (2-3 h old coins with one big buyer) made -0.19 per 20 on the untouched last 3 weeks, with almost no 3x coins (0.6% against 5.3% for the gates). Fails.
          • The bot's own scans (7 to 21 Oct, 91 numbers incl. RugCheck, creator, holders, social, smart wallets): 90,354 combinations. The best made -2.49 per 20 on the untouched last 4 days; the gates made -0.84. Fails.
          • After correcting for the number of rules tried, not one rule of either search was better than chance.
          • New launches (coins under 1 hour old) lost the most everywhere: -2.4 to -6.2 per 20 in the history, -7.8 to -10.8 in the bot's own scans (34 to 54% went to zero within 2 hours), -5.90 in the paper account (the top picks: -3.17). They do have the most 3x coins, which is why they felt better.
          ⓘ how

          Every night the search reads every coin of every scan so far (1,431,547 rows, 13,710 coins, 554 scans) with what 20 became about 2 hours later, after 1% fees per buy and per sell, the price multiple capped at 11x. It tries 35,082 rules (one or two numbers above or below a quartile, in 6 age windows, the old new launches among them) and keeps the one that did best in both halves of the scans and lost no 3x coins against the gates; a rule with about 6 of 10 coins in profit and a profit in both halves comes first. That rule is frozen with its numbers; from then on it is measured only on coins that came later, next to the gates on the same coins. It counts as better only with 100 coins or more over 3 days or more, above zero and above the gates per 20, a 3x share and a share in profit not below the gates', and the low end of its range above zero, the range widened for the number of rules under test at once (10 now). The goal of 6 of 10 counts only with a profit per pick: many small wins and a few big losses still lose money. Every rule also goes through 10,000 simulated runs: the days drawn again with replacement, a fee per side between 0.5% and 2% and a slippage up to 4% a day drawn at random; it counts as better only if 90% of those runs or more end in profit. The grey line is the typical run's paper account, the red one a bad run (1 in 20). The leading rule's mistakes line uses the bot's top picks. Fake money; nothing here changes what the bot buys.

          Big move, either way (37 of 87 numbers hold) These tell that a coin will move a lot, not which way. That is why danger signals keep looking like 3x signals.

          • trades in the last hour: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.70)
          • market cap vs an hour ago: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.69)
          • touches of the resistance: lower before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.32)
          • biggest buyer's share: lower before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.33)
          • last 5-min candle body: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.67)
          • screener change, 5 min: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.66)
          • price change, 30 min: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.66)
          • price change, 5 min: higher before big moves · holds on unseen days (strong, AUC 0.66)

          Which way: winners against losers of the same age and size (2 of 87 hold) Only these separate the 3x coins from the ones that fell 80%, and only a little.

          • buyers per seller, last hour: higher in winners · holds on unseen days (clear, AUC 0.62)
          • trades in the last hour: lower in winners · holds on unseen days (clear, AUC 0.39)
          • average trade size, last hour: higher in winners · did not hold on unseen days (clear, AUC 0.61)
          • Bollinger position: higher in winners · did not hold on unseen days (clear, AUC 0.59)
          • 3x share of coins 2-3 days ago: lower in winners · did not hold on unseen days (clear, AUC 0.41)

          ⓘ how

          4,738 coins, 24,710 hourly rows, 10 Aug to 8 Oct 2026 (unseen: from 25 Sep). Winner: reached 3x within 6 h; loser: fell to 20% or less without 3x. Numbers from one-minute charts (returns, RSI, volume spikes, buy pressure, candles, support/resistance, trend), the screener, the wallets that bought before (with their earlier results), BTC/SOL and the meme market, and the 50 most similar earlier charts. Compared like with like (age x market cap), Holm-corrected; the score is gradient boosting trained walk-forward and checked once on unseen days. Sell rule A (-30%/11x/6 h), fees as the paper account. research/winlose/.

              How a coin is sold

              Fake money, no budget. Each scan's top pick is bought on paper for 50 €; the first 5 new launches of each scan for 3 € each until Oct 16, 02:00, every coin the launch radar finds without traps for 10 € from then on. A coin that is held is not bought again. Each position sells on the live chart: 15% under its high once it has reached 1.5x, on a fall of 15% within 30 minutes, at −50%, at 11x or after 6 h, whichever comes first, all of it: on the live chart, looked at every minute: as soon as a minute's low reaches 50% of the entry price or lower (the floor, booked at that low); once a minute's high has reached 1.5 times the entry price, as soon as a minute's low falls 15% under the highest price so far (the trailing stop, booked at that low; a minute that closes under that line right after a new high, at its close); as soon as a minute closes 15% or more under its close 30 minutes before (at that close); as soon as a minute's high reaches 11 times the entry price (booked at exactly that level); 6 hours after the purchase (at that minute's price); or when the price or the liquidity is gone (the pool is gone). Each sale is booked at the minute it happened, the next scan shows it. The rule since Oct 24 (the fixed rule before it, −30% / 11x / 6 h, keeps running as a shadow rule on the same trades). Failing a filter sells nothing. Paper fees: 1% per trade, at least 0.10 €; the tip record keeps 0.5%, at least 0.81 €.

              How the learning trader decides4 changes so far · learns only from finished trades

              It starts with the stop-loss trader's rule and changes one step at a time: the stop (−20, −30 or −40%), the target (2x, 3x or 11x) or the time limit (6 h or 2 h). Once a day at 02:00 Berlin it looks only at trades that finished before then.

              A change needs at least 80 finished trades of that kind, 40 older and 40 newer; it must be better in both halves and with every way of reading coarse prices, likely better than zero, and still better without its single best trade. At most one change a day.

              It may also skip coins with a sign that lost money: at least 30 coins with and 30 without the sign, worse in both halves, at most 2 signs and at most 40% of coins skipped.

              Before Oct 16 these steps were worked out afterwards on the trades so far; from Oct 16 they are made live, before the trades happen. Only the live part shows whether learning helps.
